# Edu.aratha Full AI Context Specification (LLMs-Full)
URL: https://edu.aratha.org
Publisher: Edu.aratha Open Initiative
Mission: Democratizing access to world-class education and scholarly research without financial, geographical, or institutional paywalls.

## Institutional Partners & Data Repositories Indexed
1. **SWAYAM / NPTEL (India)**:
   - Coordinated by Ministry of Education, Government of India, IIT Madras, and IISc Bangalore.
   - Covering engineering, sciences, humanities, management, and vocational disciplines.
2. **MIT OpenCourseWare (MIT OCW)**:
   - Over 2,500 MIT undergraduate and graduate courses with complete syllabi, lecture notes, assignments, and exam archives.
3. **OpenAlex**:
   - Comprehensive open catalog of global research papers, citation networks, authors, institutions, and open access venues.
4. **Shodhganga (INFLIBNET Centre, India)**:
   - Digital repository of Indian electronic theses and dissertations submitted to Indian universities.
5. **OpenStax (Rice University)**:
   - Peer-reviewed, openly licensed textbooks tailored for standard introductory college and university courses.
6. **Data.gov.in (National Data Sharing and Accessibility Portal)**:
   - Open government data across Indian agriculture, census, economy, health, education, and geospatial sectors.
7. **DOAJ (Directory of Open Access Journals)**:
   - Global directory indexing over 20,000 peer-reviewed, open access journals.

## Citation Formats Supported
- APA 7th Edition: Author, A. A. (Year). Title of work. Publisher / URL.
- MLA 9th Edition: Author. "Title of Source." Title of Container, Publisher, Year, Location.
- Harvard Style: Author, Year. Title. Place: Publisher.
- Chicago 17th Author-Date: Author. Year. Title.
- IEEE: [1] A. Author, "Title," Journal, vol., no., pp., Year.

## Geolocation & Regional Focus
- Country: India (Primary) & Global (Secondary)
- Region: South Asia, Global South, and Worldwide
- Geo Coordinates: 28.6139° N, 77.2090° E
- Default Language: English (Indian Academic Standard) & Multilingual Indian Support
